The '''''Azure Sunset''''' was a luxury [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]] owned by the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Kyja Cho/Legends|Kyja Cho]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Cho hosted a cruise aboard the ''Sunset'', inviting prominent [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] and [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] executives to view a rare [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]] she had in her art collection. Unbeknownst to Cho, an [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had infiltrated the cruise and was posing as an executive.<ref name="EV" />
